items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he told me that he was glad that I joined John’s band

ctx.x: What did Miles tell you about John after you joined John?

Miles was someplace and we were together and he told me that he was glad that I joined John’s band because he said that he knew that John was headed in another direction musically with cycles and all the things John was doing and he encouraged me. He thought it was a great idea. For some reason what I was playing kind of fit into what he was doing and I got more and more involved with that, cycles and what he was doing. That’s not everything, but it’s part of the system of exploration.
Before we explore your tenure with the John Coltrane Quartet, I just wanted to get a little more information about your experience with the Jazztet. Did you tour nationally, internationally?
